phases.objective: Persist journal and reconciliation child evidence only after exact cleanup-run and deterministic plan-item parents exist, without changing the existing SQL state adapter, enabling foreign keys, mounting runtime composition, or applying migrations.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage SQL Child Evidence Writer Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Journal and reconciliation evidence are appended with exact run and deterministic plan-item parent bindings, contiguous phase ordering, exact replay, durable accounting, shared locking, rollback, and same-transaction readback while all live and production capabilities remain disabled.
steps: Bind factory creation to current successful signed schema verification and exact runtime parity.
Use the parent writer deterministic ID derivation to resolve the exact plan-item parent.
Acquire the same advisory lock used by the parent writer and read the run and plan-item parents with SELECT FOR UPDATE.
Reject missing, mismatched, terminal, or legacy unbound parent states.
Append prepared, result, and readback rows only in contiguous order and accept only exact replay.
Read back every immutable journal row inside the same transaction.
Compare reconciliation accounting with durable parent-aware journal rows and require complete readback for an applied outcome.
Insert and read back immutable reconciliation evidence or roll back on mismatch.
Prove no adapter expansion, foreign-key enablement, migration apply, live database access, runtime mounting, provider dispatch, or secret use occurred.
assertions: Every new journal row has a non-null deterministic plan_item_id and exact run/operation/plan binding.
Legacy rows with null plan_item_id fail closed rather than being silently mixed with parent-aware evidence.
Result requires prepared evidence and readback requires result evidence for the same plan-item parent.
Journal sequence is append-only and contiguous across the run.
Applied reconciliation requires readback evidence for every plan-item parent.
The writer remains unmounted, foreign_keys_enabled=false, provider_dispatch_allowed=false, and production_ready=false.

phases.objective: Operational mounting requires live migration apply, signed current schema verification, canonical composition, and separately governed foreign-key enablement.
Crash-safe restart convergence and live parent-child parity remain separate production slices.
No live database or provider canary is executed by this unmounted writer slice.
Production and deferred foreign-key enablement remain blocked.
